summary: Verified JMA polish round per direct user feedback (3 bugs): (a) Middle C now sits on its own ledger line BELOW the staff at y=77%, ledger line visible at 75.78% with zIndex:4 above note head; (b) handleBellTap fires playBellNote(note) on every tap before the gameState gate — no console errors during taps; (c) 'Rest Quiz' renamed to 'Sneaky Note' and 'Tempo Quiz' renamed to 'Snail or Cheetah?'; Sneaky Note mode plays a corrupted tune that fills a real rest, phase label reads 'Which note covered up the silence?' and reveal text uses the new SILENCE/REST copy. All 5 requested checks pass. Regression: Sticker Book and Detective Rookie (wrong-note mode) still work.
